verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a note-taking/knowledge-management SaaS with a developer platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a TypeScript SDK (npm @capacities/api), and an MCP server/chat connectors, but nothing describes an official command-line tool. The SDK, API and MCP endpoints are developer building blocks or adjacent integrations and earn no credit toward a CLI.
